name: VBA OpenRouter translation macro for Office 2003

mentions.name: VBA OpenRouter translation macro for Office 2003
mentions.description: A VBA macro for Office 2003 that sends the selected text to OpenRouter (Claude Sonnet or Gemini) and replaces it with the model's response, using a system prompt that instructs the model to output only the translation. The author built it to streamline translating a French novel paragraph by paragraph without copying and pasting back and forth, and reports it is a major boost to translation productivity.
mentions.problem: Copying and pasting paragraphs to and from OpenRouter for translation gets old fast, and Office 2003 has no AI features (its built-in translate function is awkward and not very good).
mentions.audience: individual writers/translators working on personal projects
mentions.source_excerpt: So I wrote a macro to send selected text to OpenRouter and replace with the response (with a system prompt that says to only output the translation, otherwise most models start with "Here's the translated text:")
